content: We have functional groups list. For SN2, forward reaction breaks halide (alkyl halide) and forms a new bond (C-N). The functional group formed is maybe "primary amines", "secondary amines", "tertiary amines" depending on nucleophile. The nucleophile could be CN (nitrile) but they said C-N formed. So we can search with functional_groups_broken = ["halide"] and functional_groups_formed = ["primary amines","secondary amines","tertiary amines","nitrile"]? Might be multiple. Let's try search with broken halide and formed primary amine. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
